mapper.select: SELECT wa.id, wa.student_id, wa.job_id, wa.work_date, CASE DAYOFWEEK(wa.work_date) WHEN 1 THEN 7 ELSE DAYOFWEEK(wa.work_date) - 1 END as day_of_week, wa.time_slot, wa.status, j.title as jobTitle, j.address, j.salary FROM work_assignment wa LEFT JOIN job j ON wa.job_id = j.id WHERE wa.student_id = #{studentId} AND wa.status IN ('assigned', 'checked_in', 'pending_confirmation') ORDER BY wa.work_date, wa.time_slot

SELECT wa.id, wa.student_id, wa.job_id, wa.work_date, CASE DAYOFWEEK(wa.work_date) WHEN 1 THEN 7 -- 周日 ELSE DAYOFWEEK(wa.work_date) - 1 END as day_of_week, wa.time_slot, wa.status, j.title as jobTitle, j.address, j.salary, u.name as studentName, u.credit as studentCredit FROM work_assignment wa LEFT JOIN job j ON wa.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN user u ON wa.student_id = u.id WHERE j.userId = #{merchantId} AND wa.status = 'assigned' ORDER BY wa.work_date, wa.time_slot
mapper.update: UPDATE work_assignment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{assignmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_assignment (student_id, job_id, merchant_requirement_id, work_date, time_slot, status, created_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{jobId}, COALESCE(#{merchantRequirementId}, 0), #{workDate}, #{timeSlot}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
